subject: general
question:
Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

Only two boxes are kept between C and E. Only A is kept above B. No box is kept below E. F is kept at some place below D but at some place above G. How many boxes are kept between A and G?
solution:
Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• Only two boxes are kept between C and E.
 
• Only A is kept above B.
 
• No box is kept below E.
 
• F is kept at some place below D but at some place above G.

The Final Arrangement is,

 
 

 
 
A

 
 
 

 
 
B

 
 
 

 
 
D

 
 
 

 
 
C

 
 
 

 
 
F

 
 
 

 
 
G

 
 
 

 
 
E

 
 
 

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
